name: plans-hero
description: Pricing v2 hero: optional internal notice strip, centred eyebrow, two-line headline (second line in the brand gradient), bold sub line, lead, two buttons, compliance badges, and a client logo band along the bottom. Source: the Asset Panda Pricing v2 mockup.

notice_label.description: Bold start of the notice strip above the hero, e.g. INTERNAL DRAFT. The strip shows only when notice_label or notice is set.

notice.description: Rest of the notice strip, e.g. Provisional pricing, not approved for publication.

eyebrow.description: Small purple label above the heading.

layout.description: hero: the centred hero (needs a title). split: the service-page hero — copy left-aligned, the Book a Demo form on the right, the logo band below (needs a title). trust: only the client logos and compliance badges, as a proof row under the plans; the heading fields are ignored.

variant.description: clean: the pricing page's quieter look (white trust band, larger split heading). The centred hero layout has one look.

form_title.description: Split layout: heading of the form card, e.g. Talk to an Expert.

form_lead.description: Split layout: line under the form card heading.

form.description: Split layout: the Book a Demo widget (the demo-booking component, embedded without its own heading). Keys passed through: view, button_label, days_heading, times_heading, duration_label, compliance_label, compliance, cal_team, cal_user, cal_event, max_days, hs_portal, hs_form, guard_url, track_path, thanks_url, thanks_preview_url, contact_email, contact_phone.

title.description: First line of the page heading (the page's h1). Required for the hero layout.

title_accent.description: Second heading line, set in the brand gradient.

lede.description: Lead paragraph under the bold line.

cta_url.description: Gradient button destination. A #anchor scrolls to that section.

badges_label.description: Small label above the compliance badges.

badges.description: Compliance badges. Each: image (URL, or a file name in this component's assets folder), alt, h (display height in px).

band_accent.description: Logo band line, purple bold part that follows band_text.

logos.description: Client logos in the band. Each: image (URL, or a file name in this component's assets folder), alt, h (display height in px).

background.description: Background art (URL, or a file name in this component's assets folder). Empty for plain white.
